experiment: A1 Security in Computing nine-method data-protection benchmark
hybrid_aad_policy: A1-Crypto-Data-Protection/Hybrid/v1\x00 followed by the common versioned header; the same construction is used for RSA, X25519, and FFDHE
hybrid_payload_format: version(1) || scheme_id(1) || key_material_length(2) || salt_length(1) || key_material || salt || nonce(12) || ciphertext || tag(16)
input_generation: existing local synthetic binary fixtures in data/inputs; same bytes reused across methods at each size; file reads are outside timed regions

key_provisioning.ffdhe: one static recipient RFC 7919 ffdhe3072 key pair provisioned before measurement; sender creates a fresh ephemeral key pair and 32-byte HKDF salt per message and transmits the 384-byte fixed-width ephemeral public value and salt
key_provisioning.rsa: one RSA-3072 recipient key pair provisioned before measurement; sender creates a fresh 32-byte AES key per message and transmits the RSA-OAEP wrapped key
key_provisioning.symmetric: one fresh 32-byte key per method per run, generated before calibration and measurement
key_provisioning.x25519: one static recipient X25519 key pair provisioned before measurement; sender creates a fresh ephemeral key pair and 32-byte HKDF salt per message and transmits the raw 32-byte ephemeral public key and salt

nonce_policy: 12-byte nonces use a random per-key 4-byte prefix plus a monotonically increasing 8-byte counter; nonce prefixes are created outside timers and every timed encryption/round-trip operation receives a new nonce
research_title: Evaluating Cryptographic Data Protection: File-Size Effects, Tamper Detection, and Trust Assumptions
statistical_unit: one row per method, input size, and measured batch; operations within a batch are normalized but not independent observations

timed_metrics.hash_digest_generation: hash function call over the in-memory payload
timed_metrics.hybrid_full_valid_round_trip: fresh sender key step, nonce, common-envelope AAD construction, AES-GCM encryption, recipient key recovery/agreement and HKDF, and valid AES-GCM decryption; fixture I/O and post-timer validation are excluded
timed_metrics.hybrid_key_step: RSA fresh AES-key generation plus OAEP wrapping, or fresh ephemeral/salt generation plus key agreement, public serialization, and HKDF; file AES-GCM is excluded
timed_metrics.symmetric_encryption: per-message nonce counter step plus AEAD encryption; key setup, payload preparation, validation, and output writing are excluded
timed_metrics.symmetric_valid_decryption: valid AEAD decryption of prebuilt envelopes; envelope preparation, validation after timing, and output writing are excluded

validation: all measured valid operations are checked after their timers stop; validation and CSV writing are outside timed regions
